include.title: Look up incentives
include.description: Check which rebate programs a customer qualifies for. Send the customer's address, classification, and devices; Leap returns the total incentive amount, a per-program breakdown, and a Connect URL the customer can use to apply.

include.title: Refresh incentives
include.description: Re-run eligibility for a customer you've already looked up, using their stored address and devices — no need to resend them. Use this to pick up newly launched programs or updated incentive amounts.

include.title: Override incentives
include.description: Replace an existing customer's device list, then re-run eligibility. Use this when a customer's equipment has changed. The previous device set is discarded.

include.title: Search applications
include.description: Search and filter the applications you're tracking. Returns a paginated list, filterable by reference ID or status.

include.title: Get application
include.description: Retrieve a single application in full, including customer information and device details.

include.title: Update application
include.description:
Provide the information you're supplying on behalf of the customer — customer details, device data, purchase and installation dates, contractor info. Only include the fields you want to change; omitted fields keep their current values.

Statuses, dates, and identifiers are read-only and can't be changed here.

include.title: List attachments
include.description: List the attachments on one or more applications. Pass `application_id` (with an `attachment_type`) for a single application, or `application_ids` (comma-separated) for several.

include.title: Upload attachment
include.description: Create a signed URL for uploading an attachment. Upload the file to that URL with a PUT request, then confirm it with the commit endpoint.

include.title: Commit attachment upload
include.description: Confirm an attachment after the file has been uploaded to its signed URL. This finalizes the attachment on the application.

include.title: Download attachment
include.description: Get a signed URL for downloading an attachment. The URL is valid for one hour.

include.title: Delete attachment
include.description: Permanently delete an attachment. This removes the file and its record and can't be undone.
